authorization: 2026-10-02 user instructed operator to resolve mechanical choices through reasoning and existing information
scope: Two explicit ASTRA research interpretations; not claims to replicate every discretionary educator decision. No ICT/FVG/trend/news/volatility filters. No adaptive parameter selection.

data.forward_exclusion: Before performance inspection: Jan2-Mar4 has16420 off-tick rows and16422 zero-volume rows, so this segment is inadmissible as MNQ execution data; never silently round or fill it. PostMar4 quality must independently pass. No test of the discarded segment.
data.timestamp_assumption: Historical header ET localized America/New_York; aware forward timestamps converted. Treat source stamp as interval OPEN and availability=stamp+1minute; if actual source close this adds latency rather than using price early. Unknown vendor convention remains deployment blocker.
data.resampling: Complete consecutive raw minute intervals only. OHLC aggregate with close-known right boundary; UTC-aware chronological processing. ET 18:00 session anchor for 4H; midnight equivalent for 1H/15M/5M/2M. Missing intervals are not filled. Drop incomplete aggregation buckets; pivot windows require contiguous expected bars. Unknown contract adjustment/roll provenance blocks deployment.

icc.pivots: Existing2-left/2-right symmetric pivot substrate. Strict greater/less than every other high/low in window; tied or dual-kind pivots excluded. Confirmation known only at rightmost bar CLOSE. Sensitivity separately1-left/1-right and3-left/3-right, no selection.
icc.indication: First HTF close crossing latest confirmed unbroken high(long)/low(short), prior close on other side. Directional candle and body>=50percent of full range operationalize user's strong momentum without an ATR/volatility filter. Freeze50percent now; sensitivities40/60percent. Both crossings same bar rejected. New indication supersedes any active one, including opposite direction. Superseded pivots never resurrect.
icc.correction: First strictly post-I completed LTF directional countertrend candle (long close<open;short close>open). Latest known HTF excursion from I through bars known by C fixes target extreme; target must be beyond entry later. Countertrend move represents liquidity-taking pressure, not an added mandatory sweep at an invented named level.
icc.structure: Online, post-C full pivot windows only. Long low->reaction high->higher low; short high->reaction low->lower high. Use first chronological adjacent alternating three-pivot sequence; replace consecutive same-kind pivot with newest only BEFORE structure frozen. Never choose earliest starting pivot conditional on future completion. Structure known at third pivot confirmation. No structural evidence before C.
icc.continuation: Strictly later LTF close crosses reaction pivot in HTF direction AND lies beyond original I level. Prior LTF close must be on other side of reaction. Original I need only directional side, matching source distinction; reaction provides actual cross. Entry next raw minute open at/after this close-known time. One emitted signal per I. If a new indication arrives first it cancels old state.
icc.invalidation: Long close below first structure low /short above first structure high cancels before entry. Setup expires after96 completed LTF bars from C; inherited research horizon, sensitivity72/120. No expiry performance selection.
icc.stop_target: Stop one tick beyond transition higher-low/lower-high pivot. Initial target known excursion extreme fixed at C. Reject if target not beyond filled entry or risk<1point; execution gap makes same check. Fixed risk1R, two equal contracts for50percent TP1 then runner. No scaling in.
icc.runner: After TP1, move residual stop to entry breakeven on NEXT minute only; then ratchet to newest confirmed same-direction protecting LTF pivot minus/plus1tick, effective only after pivot known. No loosening. Day max hold24elapsed hours; swing120elapsed hours. Exit at first raw open at/after deadline; no retrospective flatten through missing data.
icc.limits: Research interpretation of structure/strong momentum/correction/expiry/trail. Not the earlier mechanically incomplete exact-educator claim. Day/swing categorization changes holding limit, not a session filter.

vincent.name: vincent_2m
vincent.levels: Prior completed09:30-16:00 ET RTH high/low and current04:00-09:30 ET premarket high/low. Require complete prior RTH and current premarket minutes; skip days lacking these source periods. These are08:30-15:00 and03:00-08:30 Central respectively; convert timezones programmatically.
vincent.ntz: At RTH open, nearest lower and upper levels bracketing opening price form NTZ. Trade only outward through upper boundary long or lower boundary short; if open outside all levels, nearest level behind price may be retested in opening direction. Frozen level rank distance then label alphabetically for exact ties.
vincent.break: A completed2M close crosses selected level outward; gap outside at open also eligible. Never enter breakout bar.
vincent.retest: Subsequent bar touches selected level within1tick and closes back on breakout side. Freeze rejection-bar high/low as battle-zone bounds; no fixed3-5 candle wait. If later bar closes through opposite rejection bound cancel. Setup expires at16:00 ET; later clean crossing can create new setup after cancellation.
vincent.confirmation: Strictly later2M close breaks rejection/battle-zone high for long or low for short, remaining outside NTZ. Prior close inside/on bound. This is an explicit minimal flag/consolidation-break interpretation. Next1M open entry. One event per break/retest; no same-bar retest/entry.
vincent.stop_target: Stop1tick beyond frozen rejection extreme. TP1 most extreme price from break through bars BEFORE retest, frozen upon retest. Reject target behind entry or risk<1point. Two equal contracts,50percent partial at TP1; runner then breakeven and confirmed2L/2R2M protecting pivot trail effective next minute only. Flat at16:00 ET/15:00 Central first available open.
vincent.sensitivity: Retest tolerance0/2ticks around base1tick; execution3M around base2M; no selecting winners.
vincent.source_limit: Vincent also discusses ES/NQ/SPY/QQQ alignment and discretionary NTZ/runner decisions. This is explicitly NQ-only core-pattern research. No claim of full Vincent fidelity or deployment PASS without independently sourced synchronized multi-market confirmation evidence. Missing alignment is a deployment limitation, never falsely labeled satisfied.

execution.signal_schema: strategy,direction(+1/-1),decision_time UTC,stop,target,expiry_time UTC,structure_known_time UTC,indication_time UTC,correction_time UTC; optional provenance fields. Decision fields only. Entry simulator separately uses next raw open.
execution.accounting: Each strategy independently one position at a time; skip signals while a position remains open including same-minute exit. Across variants no portfolio sum. Overlap measured on all candidates.
execution.costs: NQ:20USD/point/contract,5USD roundtrip commission/fees per contract; MNQ:2USD/point/contract,1.50USD roundtrip. ASSUMED all-in stressable costs, not broker quote. One tick adverse entry and every exit including target (conservative market-on-touch). Stress2ticks and2xfees. Targets cannot be guaranteed fills.
execution.order: 1M path resolution. Gap stops fill at worse open; stop and target same minute=>stop first. Count ambiguities. Partial then runner cannot improve stop until next minute. Time exits at available open. No use of future extrema. Data-end/partition-end open trades marked censored and excluded with counts, not fake realized PnL.
execution.risk: Initial filled-entry to fixed stop distance; min1point. Fixed2 contracts; report netR and per2contract USD. Prop diagnostics assumed50k/2000USD static drawdown only, no actual firm feasibility claim without chosen firm/rules.

gates.before_performance: Nonvacuous regression tests; raw truncation for EVERY emitted candidate at its decision time with matching full fields, using reusable streaming checkpoints when equivalent; deliberately broken future-dependent control must fail. No pass by metadata-only audit. Source fidelity limitations explicit.
gates.minimum_samples: At least100 nonoverlap forward-OOS trades per base strategy variant and30 in each direction; minimum3 distinct OOS months. Sparse result is INSUFFICIENT, not proof of no edge.
gates.acceptance: Positive net expectancy under base and stress costs in validation and forwardOOS; block bootstrap95percent lower mean>0; PF>1; top5 share of gross profit<=25percent; neighboring sensitivity directions do not reverse expectancy; no month>50percent total positive profit; no causal failure; no material source/data fidelity gap. Otherwise no deployment.
gates.metrics: N,meanR,PF,winrate,win/loss quantiles,drawdown starting at0,tail loss,streaks,duration,monthly/directional slices,source gap/ambiguity/overlap/censor counts,concentration,bootstrap intervals,random-entry same-exit diagnostic and source/execution limitations. Market-condition diagnostics never used as filters.
gates.multiple_tests: Three ICC variants plus Vincent base; sensitivity counted separately, no selection. Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap/null evidence across base family where computed. All prior ASTRA model mining remains a caveat; old2025 is reused test, not untouchedOOS.
